verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage's marketing pages describe in-product AI agents for customer screening/ongoing monitoring and transaction monitoring. These agents auto-remediate level 1 alerts and escalate high-risk cases, and users can review or override any agent decision, so the AI does produce outputs from the user's data. However, the evidence frames these as automated decisions, not as surfaced insights or recommendations, and consists only of thin marketing snippets. Missing for 10: documentation of AI-generated insights, explanations or suggestions shown to users; detail on how agent rationale is presented in the UI; independent or hands-on corroboration.
